name: Geir Engdahl
current_role: Co-founder and Chief Technology Officer, AI, Cognite (Oslo)
profile: Norwegian technologist who co-founded industrial-data/AI software company Cognite in 2016 with John Markus Lervik and others. Previously founded ML classifieds startup Snapsale (acquired by Schibsted in 2017) and was a senior software engineer at Google. Served as Cognite CTO, then Chief Product Officer (2024), and was named CTO, AI in May 2025.
interesting_fact: Before Cognite he founded Snapsale (2011), a machine-learning classifieds startup he ran as CEO/CTO until Schibsted acquired it in 2017.
deep_cut_fact: He won a silver medal at the International Olympiad in Informatics, and holds a master's in computational science from the University of Oslo.
notes: Press contact is Cognite's VP Global PR (Michelle Holford) as listed in 2024 release; may have changed. Role update: https://itbrief.co.uk/story/cognite-appoints-ai-leaders-to-drive-innovation-push

name: Matias Muchnick
current_role: Co-founder and CEO, NotCo (The Not Company)
profile: Chilean entrepreneur who co-founded NotCo in 2015 with Karim Pichara and Pablo Zamora, using its AI 'Giuseppe' to formulate plant-based foods (NotMilk, NotMayo); backed by Jeff Bezos' fund and valued at ~$1.5B+. In 2025-26 NotCo pivoted toward selling its AI formulation platform to food majors (Kraft Heinz JV, Ferrero, Coca-Cola), exiting several consumer markets.
interesting_fact: Named to TIME's Next Generation Leaders; NotCo attracted investors including Bezos Expeditions and Roger Federer.
deep_cut_fact: Before NotCo he left finance to launch Eggless, a vegan mayonnaise brand in Chile; earlier still his first startup, a gamified-wellness app called Chooz, was in his words 'a total failure'.
notes: Active on LinkedIn and frequent podcast guest. No published press email found in quick search; go via NotCo comms (notco.com).

name: Francisco Padilla
current_role: Co-founder of Konfío (Mexico City SME lender); described as growth director / formerly CTO
profile: Mexican technologist who co-founded Konfío in 2013 with David Arana, building its AI-driven self-service SME credit platform; Konfío became a unicorn in 2021 (~$1.3B valuation) and has since obtained a banking licence. Padilla has held CTO/CIO and growth-director titles; Arana is CEO.
interesting_fact: Konfío's very first loan, for 10,000 pesos, was made in January 2014; by 2024-25 the company was disbursing more than 17 billion pesos and had backed ~80,000 businesses.
deep_cut_fact: A 2007 Tec de Monterrey computer-technologies grad, he met co-founder David Arana while both worked at MicroStrategy in New York (Citibank was its biggest client) during the 2008 crisis; his parents, both systems engineers, advised him not to quit.
notes: Low public profile compared with CEO David Arana; current exact title unclear (El CEO interview calls him cofundador y director de crecimiento: https://elceo.com/negocios/konfio-del-unicornio-fintech-al-reto-de-convertirse-en-banco/). Best route via Konfío corporate comms.

name: Sean Hendelman
current_role: CEO, Active Trading division, Clear Street (since May 2024); co-founder and board member, Public.com
profile: New York trading entrepreneur who founded T3 (T3 Live, T3 Trading Group), a trading, training and technology provider for professional traders, and co-founded social investing app Public.com, where he sits on the board. In 2024 prime broker Clear Street hired him to run its active trading division.
interesting_fact: Spent most of a 25+ year career running T3, building a global platform spanning equities, options, futures and algorithmic trading, before co-founding retail investing app Public.com.
notes: Clear Street bio: https://www.clearstreet.io/about/team/sean-hendelman (page errored on fetch). No published personal contact found; route via Clear Street media relations.
